heroHeadline: BJP opens fresh Jharkhand flashpoint: 4-day statewide siege demands CBI probe, case withdrawals for JPSC/JSSC protesters
heroSubtitle: State BJP president Aditya Sahu launched a four-day agitation on Sep 8, sieging DC/SP offices in six districts to demand a CBI probe into JPSC/JSSC recruitment-exam irregularities and withdrawal of cases against protesting students, with Leader of Opposition Babulal Marandi and former CM Raghubar Das leading district wings. The party's tally of '300+' students still facing cases sits well below the 600-1,600+ bookings reported by press tallies in August, leaving the true scale of prosecutions unreconciled. The CJP's internal fracture into CJP and CJP-Democratic, the Bihar TRE-4 postponement and the Jamia admissions dispute remain unchanged since their early-September developments.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
